name: KISS x 300 Konna Sekai
source:
Main character works as a publisher until he gets fired. He goes on an interview for the visionary revitalizer job to the "Purple Powerful" company. Astonishing beauty interviewer says that "only kiss matters". She only asks questions about favorite kinds of kisses and then invites to kiss her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本在出版社工作，后来遭到解雇。他前往“Purple Powerful”公司，参加所谓前瞻性振兴师职位的面试。美得惊人的面试官表示，“只有接吻最重要”。她只询问主人公喜欢怎样的吻，随后邀请他亲吻自己…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
